name: Jayant Infratech Ltd.
summary: Jayant Infratech Ltd. operates as a technologically advanced enterprise primarily engaged in the development of railway infrastructure. The company offers a comprehensive suite of services for single-phase traction overhead equipment, encompassing everything from initial design and detailed engineering plans to procurement, installation, and final commissioning. Established on July 7, 2003, its corporate headquarters are situated in Bilaspur, India.
